related.note: NIS2 regulates entities and services; the Cyber Resilience Act regulates products with digital elements. They overlap at the supply-chain and incident-reporting layer but are separate EU acts.
Both are EU internal law. The AI Act contains cybersecurity duties for certain AI systems; the Cyber Resilience Act is the horizontal product-security layer.
